evals.prompt: 帮我用 llm-api-test 测一下 deepseek 的 API 兼容性，跑完给我出一份报告
evals.expected_output: A markdown compatibility report saved under reports/, produced by running ./llm-api-test compatibility against the deepseek config(s). Should run all api-formats (default all) against the right configs (chat/responses from config.deepseek.yaml, messages from config.deepseek.anthropic.yaml), summarize PASS/FAIL per case, and explain any failures.

evals.prompt: 对比一下 deepseek 官方和 cuberouter 的响应延迟，用 responses API，出个对比报告
evals.expected_output: A markdown comparison report: latency benchmark (./llm-api-test latency, --api-format responses) run on both config.deepseek.yaml and config.cuberouter.yaml, results compared side by side (p50/p95/p99 Total, TTFB, failures), with a speed-gap and stability analysis and a recommendation. Structured JSON (-o) saved for table building.

evals.prompt: 跑个 deepseek chat 的 throughput 看看，3x3，然后出报告
evals.expected_output: A markdown throughput report: ./llm-api-test throughput --api-format chat -c config.deepseek.yaml --iterations 3 --concurrency 3, with TPOT/TPS/Tokens/Output indicators, cost warning given before running, JSON report saved, and a report file with the results.

evals.prompt: 对比 astraflow-ds 和 self-deploy-ds 两个部署的兼容性和延迟，出中文对比报告，带 HTML 图表页
evals.expected_output: A Chinese-language comparison report (markdown saved under reports/ plus an HTML chart page). The HTML file must start with <meta charset="utf-8"> before <title> so Chinese text renders correctly when the file is opened directly (file:// or a static server); charts inline SVG, results table, stability notes, recommendation. If the HTML page is viewed in a browser, no mojibake in Chinese text.
